title: Grandma Has a Proverb for Everything
logline: Whatever goes wrong, my grandmother has a proverb ready, and in the end the whole family sits together over her coffee.
audience: My family and friends, watching on their phones
intent: They should laugh and recognise their own grandmother in her proverb for every situation, then feel warm about sitting together over coffee.

intro.title: Grandma Has a Proverb for Everything
intro.description: Ten small mishaps. Ten proverbs. One grandmother who always knows what to say.

shots.reason: Introduce Grandmother and the running joke: she has a proverb for every situation. The first proverb is about allowing progress to happen gradually.
shots.image_prompt: In a sunlit highland compound, the grandmother sits on a low wooden stool beside a tiny seedling in a tin-can planter, leaning forward with her white netela slipping off one shoulder as she turns an earthenware coffee tray so the child can see. A barefoot grandchild in a faded yellow shirt crouches beside her, impatiently poking the soil with one finger. Behind them a round tukul roof, eucalyptus trees and terraced green hills, golden morning light, dust motes in the air, both faces clearly visible
